thread:
julio: RCA posted for the rate-limit regression that impacted hosted API yesterday. Full writeup and timeline here: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/1865432100 

incident-bot: RCA published: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/1865432100 — TL;DR: mis-tuned global rate limiter + rollout tag mismatch caused ~15% 5xx spike across some production routes; automatic fallback didn’t kick for blue pool.

sarah: reading now. quick q — which deploy introduced the tag mismatch? @aj?
aj: that was me. I pushed the runtime config change in v2.14 at 02:12 UTC. rollback hook existed but tags for blue pool didn’t match due to a typo in the deploy manifest.

maya: thanks for the clarity. from the RCA, key action items I pulled out: 1) fix tagging logic in rollout manifests (owner: aj) — due 2026-03-28; 2) add automated canary for rate-limit config changes + gate (owners: sarah + eng-sre) — due 2026-04-04; 3) update runbook and fallback thresholds (owner: anna) — due 2026-03-31.

julio: adding a cadence: weekly checkpoint for 4 weeks post-incident. first sync Mon 2026-03-30 9:30 PT. I'll create the calendar invite and attach the tracker.

anna: small correction — my name is anna not anna; will take runbook. (typo) I'll draft the runbook PR and include test cases for fallback thresholds.

aj: rolling back the bad tag now, will post status.
deploy-bot: Started rollback of runtime v2.14 -> v2.13 (job 5872). ETA ~6m.
aj: rollback finished. health checks passing. monitoring for 20m.
sarah: dashboards show errors back to baseline (~+0.3% over normal). looks stable.

maya: noted follow-ups we should track: (a) CI check for tag parity across pools; (b) short-term metric alert for sudden rate-limit delta > 5% relative change; (c) add a canary gate step to the release checklist.

julio: assigned action owners: aj (tagfix + rollback robust), sarah (canary design + eng-sre coordination), anna (runbook + thresholds), maya (release checklist update). I'll post an action tracker and link Linear items.

sarah: added Linear tasks and linked to RCA card: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/RI-1287 

maya: appreciate the fast turnaround everyone. :thumbsup: 
aj: a quick technical note — I'll also open a small spike to dedupe rate-limit configs per-customer to prevent config drift post-rollout. ETA for spike: 2w.
julio: admin note — classifying this incident as Sev3 (service impact but limited duration). we'll follow progress in #eng-runtime for the implementation work. ping me if blocked.
sarah: ack.

anna: PR for runbook changes targeted by EOD Friday, will request reviews from maya + sarah.
julio: closing loop here — RCA: https://redwood-internal/docs/postmortems/1865432100. Owners, update your Linear tasks and join the first sync if you're listed. If you need to reassign, please do so before the checkpoint.
